content_sections.heading: About Bharathiar University
content_sections.text: Bharathiar University is a State University in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Its letterhead describes it as accredited with an A++ Grade (3.63 CGPA) by NAAC and ranked 46th among Indian universities by MoE-NIRF.

content_sections.heading: Bharathiar University Additional Controller of Examinations Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is a maximum of 57 years as on the date of notification. A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned / allied / relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks, or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed. A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and / or research in an academic / research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution / Industry. A minimum of seven publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals. A total research score of Seventy five (75) as per the criteria given in Appendix, Table 2. SC/ST candidates get a 5% relaxation at the Master's level, from 55% to 50% of the marks. Ph.D. degree holders who passed their Master Degree prior to 19 September 1991 get a 5% relaxation, from 55% to 50% of the marks. 'B' in the seven point scale with UGC letter grades O, A, B, C, D, E and F is regarded as equivalent to 55% whenever the grading system is followed. Candidates need knowledge of Tamil to the extent of carrying official correspondence and drafting reports. Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection procedure will be as per the decision of the Syndicate of Bharathiar University. Applicants should be prepared to come for an interview at their own cost. The University will follow a transparency procedure as per Government Letter No.7582/K2/2021-1, dated 09.06.2021.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be required to join duty immediately. On joining, the candidate must enter into an agreement with the University in accordance with its laws. Pay protection will not be guaranteed in any manner to candidates already in service.

faq.question: Q1. How many copies of the application must I submit?
faq.answer: You must submit eight copies. A candidate in service who faces a delay in forwarding may first send seven advance copies to the Registrar.

faq.question: Q2. In whose favour should the Demand Draft be drawn?
faq.answer: The Demand Draft must be drawn in favour of the Registrar, Bharathiar University, Coimbatore.

faq.question: Q3. How many publications and what research score are required?
faq.answer: You need at least seven publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75 under Appendix, Table 2.

faq.question: Q4. Can SC/ST candidates apply with 50% marks in their Master's Degree?
faq.answer: Yes. SC/ST candidates get a 5% relaxation, which brings the requirement down from 55% to 50% at the Master's level.

faq.question: Q5. Is knowledge of Tamil required?
faq.answer: Yes. You must know Tamil well enough to carry out official correspondence and draft reports.

faq.question: Q6. Will candidates in service be called for interview on the basis of advance copies alone?
faq.answer: No. They will be considered and called for interview only if their applications are forwarded through proper channel and received in time.

faq.question: Q7. When must the No Objection Certificate be produced?
faq.answer: It must be produced at the time of interview. It should be obtained from the Appropriate Authority / Management.

faq.question: Q8. Can I design my own application format?
faq.answer: No. You must use a downloaded or photocopied copy of the application form, and the Information Sheet must go with each application.
